findings.title: Review/test route integration is not concretely grounded
findings.fix: Name the exact practice page and navigation component/file, specify the sibling-route versus existing-route decision, and define exact runtime assertions for owner, shared, subject-shared, legacy, and missing cases.

findings.title: Enumeration state does not define the hook transition boundary
findings.location: Shared evaluation, quota, and state transitions
findings.fix: Define submitEnumerationTerm/selectEnumerationOption lifecycle and signatures: intermediate attempts must not call answerQuestion or transition mastery; quota completion must atomically create the final transition and pending advance once, with advance as the only reset path.

findings.title: Retry/re-presentation semantics are unspecified
findings.fix: Key state by session presentation/attempt, restore partial state only for the same presentation, and explicitly clear/start fresh state on struggle retry while retaining history separately.

findings.title: DTO and persistence scope is too broad to implement
findings.fix: List exact DTOs, API schemas/routes, SQL migration, and repository mappers; specify column type, null/default behavior, and missing/null/valid-empty/malformed round-trip behavior.

findings.title: Term/distractor identity collision rules are incomplete
findings.fix: Export one identity-key function using the exact core equivalence policy; drop distractors whose keys collide with canonical terms, deduplicate all remaining values by that key, and define deterministic IDs.

findings.title: Explicit terms versus legacy-option quota is underspecified
findings.fix: State whether extra explicit terms are invalid or truncated when legacy options determine total; never truncate silently, mark fewer-than-total unique terms unavailable, and add all count-mismatch cases to tests.

findings.title: Public payload privacy boundary is not specified
findings.fix: Define separate internal and public/shared projections and omit answer_terms and enumeration_distractors from hidden-key payloads; test serialized responses and rendered markup.

findings.title: Design test plan mixes implementation execution with review
findings.fix: Keep builds, typechecks, and browser smoke tests as implementation acceptance steps and identify their exact commands separately.
